name: Superhuman Docs
description: Connect Claude with Superhuman Docs to bring your docs, tables, and data into your AI workflow. Create new docs and tables from simple descriptions; turn rough notes into polished, shareable write-ups; update existing tables & charts without leaving the conversation; and search your content right from claude without needing to dig through your workspace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Superhuman Docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Superhuman Docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://docs.superhuman.com/apis/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Superhuman Docs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Superhuman Docs lists 32 MCP tools, including tool_guide, name_match, url_convert, document_create, document_delete, document_outline, page_create, page_update, page_delete, page_describe, content_read, and content_modify.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Superhuman Docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Superhuman Docs in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Superhuman Docs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Superhuman Docs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Superhuman Docs is developed by Superhuman. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
